list: the official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list. Guides are written in our own words for this entry; each guide names the sources its facts come from. Where no source has confirmed a method yet, the guide says so instead of guessing.

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task: finish the story, the 100% checklist and the side clean-up, and this is the reward. Nothing here needs multiplayer or DLC.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The big one: finish the in-game 100% Completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, visible only after the story). It is far more forgiving than it sounds — PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion: most collectible types only need a share (for example 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles), while robberies, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunts need everything. Nothing on the checklist is missable; all of it can be done in free-roam after the story. The full checklist is in the Roadmap section of this guide.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix the categories and pick the easiest; PowerPyx notes under-bridge flights are the quickest. The 100% checklist wants 300, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or drone race), and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most of them happen naturally while you chase other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges at the 12 ranges. Golds are needed in full for the 100% checklist too, so this is a stage-2 grind; PowerPyx rates the medals as not too difficult.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations (42 races in total across them). The 100% checklist also wants all 42 drone time trials, so this comes with that grind.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations. Any race type counts; the 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 won, so keep racing past 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you about a fishing spot (purple map icon). Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge he sets.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games ('Video Games' in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home (available from Chapter 1), or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the map. You must reach the end of the game; beating every side challenge is not required.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline, Lucia only. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3; Andy calls, then texts her address in Belville. Five quests in total (the Cellerica chain) ending with the final one. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline, marked automatically in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector and bring them back. He goes quiet for a stretch of Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3, so he is not missable; track him under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline, marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Five jobs in total, ending with the last one. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands around Leonida. Only certain questlines count — PowerPyx confirms Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete among them, and notes more are still being found; the big optional questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie) do not count. All of them remain available after the story; watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list for your count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's optional questline, marked after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. Randy then wants 16 sports cars delivered; his list is under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List, and marked cars appear on the map. Deliver them in good condition for more pay. Doable after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline, Jason only, marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs (purple markers, 'Take Out Kitty Litter'), then Tyrone gives the final quest 'Spin On This'. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. THE ONE TO WATCH: PowerPyx flags the first meditation as possibly missable — in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she goes to the balcony to meditate, and you must follow and choose Accept. That balcony session adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy. Do it anyway — it costs nothing. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, but the trophy wants all 18. The final spot needs both characters together, unlocked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline, Jason only. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason and marks the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots (purple icons); hunt the animals he asks for and bring them back. He hands you the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest. The trophy pops for the unique animal — PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal triggers it — and his 15 Target Decks are required in full for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets found, so this pops early in that grind.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 on a scannable object). There are far more than 100 — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — so scan whatever you pass. It overlaps with the vehicle scanning you do for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (Progress > Challenges). The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so this pops on the way; pick the easiest ones and leave the hardest 10 undone.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and escape the heat (the red zone). You can only roam as a pair after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call your partner with the partner button. PowerPyx's tip: a fast sports bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia shakes the search. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without ever losing your wanted level. Keep the flashing red/blue wanted level (not the red heat level) the whole time, and loot something in each shop. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop — if it does not, hit a fourth. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app: stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes — scanning is enough, you do not have to drive them. The game has 557 vehicles at launch; the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base models scanned, so this comes free with that.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming). It slows time and drains the purple focus bar, so boost it first — eat or drink, wash up at home, and pop Adrenaline to stretch it. Line up a group (gang operation enemies work; it does not seem to trigger on soldiers, police or civilians), wear body armor and use a full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556. Focus levels up as you play ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA — the one at terminals E3/E4 is easiest: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge and walk straight in. Go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport; the pop is slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies on the map. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (do not kick it), find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 (after his earlier quests). Each vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast bike, then swap cars to lose the heat. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that opens bank vaults counts — tailing the truck to a bank and robbing the vault covers it. Earlier option: block a truck near a bank, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it, then escape the red heat radius.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map. Fly a plane over every blacked-out patch until the whole map is visible; PowerPyx recommends doing it by air rather than driving.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (39 operations in total). Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them and many are marked from story progress. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Method not confirmed yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown: the description is 'Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.' The plain reading is to order a cocktail somewhere overlooking Ocean Beach and wait for the pop — but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger, so treat any specific bar or spot as unconfirmed until a source pins it down.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Method not confirmed yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown: 'Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.' The description suggests driving a car out through a showroom's glass front, but no guide has confirmed which showroom or how the game counts it — do not trust a specific location until a source confirms it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations — steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. You first visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and if you miss an item the robbery icon respawns later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time. Strength is under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). You can only train as a pair after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call your partner and work out together at a fitness club (filter Map > Activities for gyms); while one trains, the other trains too, so progress doubles. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the game counts them; check your total by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on the notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) so a small demon face flags each one. Anything from clean stealth robberies to violent rampages counts, and it builds passively while you chase other trophies. If you are short at the end, PowerPyx notes it can be farmed quickly — but beware the Irredeemable profile is permanent and makes police far more aggressive.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Method not confirmed yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue; the description is 'Second time's the charm.' The honest reading: it likely involves retrying something at that store, but no source has confirmed the trigger — do not treat the guess as a fact.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Method not confirmed yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to come from a UFO questline; the description is 'What the hell just happened?' Until a guide confirms the questline's steps, the only honest advice is to keep an eye out for strange encounters while exploring and check back once a source confirms it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Method not confirmed yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be about kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle ('Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by'). The belief is unconfirmed, so treat it as a lead to test, not a fact.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts (fences). First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and payday loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is cumulative across robberies, and bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in one hit, so this comes naturally with the robbery grind.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative, any shops count. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages for $160,000 in total. They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone. The 4 story garages do not count toward this trophy. Robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the quickest way to fund them.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: gamesrecon — All GTA 6 Garage Locations and Prices

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses; drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. You need enough garage space first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Early on Moses only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Use cheap cars and bikes to keep the cost down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
